abstract: OBJECTIVE: Our purpose was to evaluate the surgical management and outcome of laparoscopic removal of benign cystic teratomas during pregnancy. STUDY DESIGN: The records of women with benign cystic teratomas who were managed with operative laparoscopy during pregnancy were reviewed. RESULTS: Twelve women had laparoscopic removal of a benign cystic teratoma during pregnancy. Gestational ages at surgery ranged from 9 to 17 weeks, with a mean of 14 weeks. Cyst size ranged from 5 to 13 cm, with a mean of 8.5 cm. Intraoperative rupture of the cyst occurred in 10 of 12 (93%) women. No patient had evidence of chemical peritonitis. The mean operating time was 87 minutes and the mean postoperative hospital stay was 44 hours. No intraoperative or postoperative maternal or fetal complications occurred. CONCLUSIONS: Laparoscopic removal of a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary may be safely accomplished during pregnancy. In spite of a significant risk of cyst rupture, careful operative technique followed by copious irrigation of the pelvis may avoid chemical peritonitis and potential adverse sequelae.
abstract_ja:
目的：妊娠中に腹腔鏡下で良性嚢胞性奇形腫を摘出した場合の外科的管理と転帰を評価すること。
研究デザイン：妊娠中に腹腔鏡手術を受けた良性嚢胞性奇形腫の女性の記録を後方視的に調べた。
結果：12名の女性が妊娠中に良性嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔鏡下摘出を受けた。手術時の妊娠週数は9〜17週、平均14週であった。嚢胞の大きさは5〜13cm、平均8.5cmであった。術中の嚢胞破裂は12名中10名(93%)で発生した。化学性腹膜炎を示した患者はいなかった。平均手術時間は87分、術後の平均入院期間は44時間であった。術中・術後の母体または胎児の合併症は発生しなかった。
結論：妊娠中の卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔鏡下摘出は安全に行いうる。嚢胞破裂のリスクは大きいが、慎重な手術操作と骨盤内の十分な洗浄により、化学性腹膜炎およびその潜在的な有害な続発症を回避しうる。
